title: DevOps Engineer Fresher
description:
**Job Description – DevOps Engineer**

**Company: LYFnGO Technologies**

**Location: Coimbatore (Work from Office)**

**Experience: 0-6 Months**

**Employment Type: Trainee for 6 months and Full Time conversion based on performance**

**About LYFnGO Technologies**

LYFnGO Technologies is a fast-growing HealthTech company focused on building innovative digital solutions for healthcare, fitness, wellness, and sports industries. We are looking for a passionate and proactive DevOps Engineer to join our team and help manage, automate, and optimize our cloud infrastructure and deployment processes.

**Job Summary**

We are seeking a **DevOps Engineer with knowleded on experience** in cloud infrastructure, CI/CD automation, Kubernetes, monitoring, and server administration. The ideal candidate should be comfortable working with cloud platforms, deployment pipelines, infrastructure automation, and monitoring tools to ensure high availability, performance, and security of applications.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, implement, and maintain CI/CD pipelines for application deployment and release management.
* Manage and support cloud infrastructure on **AWS** and **Google Cloud Platform (GCP)**.
* Deploy, monitor, and maintain containerized applications on **Amazon EKS (Elastic Kubernetes Service)**.
* Provision and manage infrastructure using **Terraform**.
* Configure and maintain build and deployment pipelines using:
* GitLab CI/CD
* Jenkins
* Bitbucket Pipelines
* Monitor application and infrastructure performance using:
* Grafana
* Prometheus
* AWS CloudWatch
* ELK Stack (Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana)
* Uptime Kuma
* Manage Linux-based and On-Premises servers.
* Troubleshoot production issues and perform root cause analysis.
* Implement infrastructure security best practices and access controls.
* Automate routine operational tasks using scripting and DevOps tools.
* Collaborate with development teams to streamline deployment processes and improve system reliability.
* Maintain documentation related to infrastructure, deployments, and monitoring systems.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

**Cloud Platforms**

* AWS
* Google Cloud Platform (GCP)

**CI/CD & Build Tools**

* GitLab CI/CD
* Jenkins
* Bitbucket Pipelines

**Infrastructure & Containerization**

* Terraform
* Amazon EKS (Kubernetes)
* Docker (Preferred)

**Monitoring & Logging**

* Grafana
* Prometheus
* AWS CloudWatch
* ELK Stack
* Uptime Kuma

**Server Administration**

* Linux Administration
* On-Premises Server Management

**Additional Skills**

* Git Version Control
* Shell/Bash Scripting
* Networking Concepts (DNS, Load Balancers, SSL/TLS)
* Troubleshooting and Performance Optimization
* Infrastructure Security Best Practices

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with Docker and Kubernetes administration.
* Familiarity with Python or Shell scripting.
* Understanding of cloud security and cost optimization.
* Exposure to multi-cloud and hybrid infrastructure environments.
* AWS or GCP certifications will be an added advantage.

Pay: ₹5,000.00 - ₹10,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: SRE / Cloud Operations Support Engineer ( Tamil nadu only )
description:
**Job Summary**

We are looking for an **SRE / Cloud Operations Support Engineer with 1–3 years of relevant experience** in cloud operations and production support. The candidate will be responsible for monitoring cloud-hosted applications, responding to alerts, managing incidents, troubleshooting production issues, and ensuring service reliability.

The current infrastructure is primarily hosted on **Microsoft Azure & AWS** , with an ongoing migration to **Google Cloud Platform (GCP)**. The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience with monitoring tools, incident management, Linux systems, and basic infrastructure automation.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Monitor applications, services, and infrastructure hosted on Azure and support the transition to GCP.
* Monitor and respond to alerts from Datadog and PagerDuty within defined Service Level Agreements (SLAs).
* Perform first-level incident triage, root-cause investigation, and troubleshooting.
* Execute documented runbooks to resolve recurring production issues.
* Monitor critical overnight jobs, scheduled processes, and batch processing activities.
* Identify, report, and escalate production incidents and potential service disruptions.
* Support monitoring configuration, alert tuning, and noise-reduction initiatives.
* Contribute to runbook documentation and operational process improvements.
* Assist with infrastructure configuration changes using Git and basic Terraform workflows.
* Coordinate with the internal SRE, DevOps, and engineering teams to resolve complex issues.
* Maintain accurate incident logs, resolution notes, and shift handover documentation.
* Follow established operational procedures and security best practices.

Mandatory Skills

* **Cloud Operations:** Microsoft Azure and/or GCP cloud environments.
* **Monitoring & Alerting:** Datadog and PagerDuty.
* **Production Support:** Incident management, alert response, and troubleshooting.
* **Operating Systems:** Linux/Unix fundamentals, command-line operations, and log analysis.
* **Infrastructure as Code:** Basic Terraform knowledge.
* **Version Control:** Git fundamentals, branching, and pull requests.
* **Cloud Infrastructure:** Understanding of virtual machines, cloud services, and infrastructure monitoring.
* **Networking:** Basic knowledge of DNS, TCP/IP, ports, connectivity, and firewalls.
* **Problem-Solving:** Ability to investigate issues, follow runbooks, and escalate incidents appropriately.

Preferred Skills

* Python, Bash, or PowerShell scripting.
* CI/CD pipeline fundamentals.
* Observability concepts, including metrics, logs, and traces.
* Alert tuning, alert noise reduction, and monitoring optimization.
* Exposure to Docker and Kubernetes.
* Familiarity with Azure DevOps and cloud migration activities.
* Basic understanding of AWS cloud services.

Required Qualifications

* **Experience:** 0–3 years in SRE support, cloud operations, DevOps support, or production support.
* **Education:** B.E./B.Tech in any specialization or MCA.
* Practical troubleshooting skills and the ability to work in a production environment.
* Willingness to support scheduled overnight monitoring and shift handovers, as required.

Job Details

* **Role:** SRE / Cloud Operations Support Engineer
* **Industry:** IT Services & Consulting
* **Department:** IT & Information Security
* **Employment Type:** Full-Time, Permanent
* **Role Category:** IT & Information Security – Other

Pay: Up to ₹350,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Internet reimbursement
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund
* Work from home

Ability to commute/relocate:

* Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu 641004: Reliably commute or planning to relocate before starting work (Required)

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
**Job Title:** Devops Engineer

**Experience :** 5-8+ years

**Location:** Coimbatore

**Contact number:** 8056866655

**Job Summary:** The Technical Lead is responsible for leading a team of engineers in the design, implementation, maintenance, and troubleshooting of Linux-based systems. This role requires a deep understanding of Linux systems, network architecture, and software development processes. The Technical Lead will drive innovation, ensure system stability, and lead the team in delivering high-quality infrastructure solutions that align with the organization's goals.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* **Leadership and Team Management:**
* Lead and mentor a team of Linux engineers, providing technical guidance and fostering professional growth.
* Manage workload distribution, ensuring that projects and tasks are completed on time and within scope.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to align IT infrastructure with organizational objectives.
* SLA & ITIL, Inventory Management
* **System Design and Implementation:**
* Architect, deploy, and manage robust Linux-based environments, including servers, networking, and storage solutions.
* Ensure the scalability, reliability, and security of Linux systems.
* Oversee the automation of system deployment and management processes using tools such as Ansible, Puppet, or Chef.
* Database management, MySQL, MongoDB, Elasticsearch, Postgres
* **Maintenance and Troubleshooting:**
* Lead efforts in monitoring, maintaining, and optimizing system performance.
* Proactively identify potential issues and implement solutions to prevent system outages.
* Resolve complex technical problems escalated from the support team.
* **Security and Compliance:**
* Implement and maintain security best practices for Linux systems, including patch management, firewall configuration, and access controls.
* Ensure compliance with relevant industry standards and regulations (e.g., HIPAA, GDPR, PCI-DSS).
* **Documentation and Reporting:**
* Develop and maintain comprehensive documentation of systems, processes, and procedures.
* Prepare and present regular reports on system performance, incidents, and improvement initiatives to senior management.
* **Continuous Improvement:**
* Stay up-to-date with the latest Linux technologies, tools, and practices.
* Lead initiatives to improve the efficiency, reliability, and security of Linux environments.
* Drive innovation in infrastructure management, including the adoption of cloud technologies and containerization.

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent work experience.
* 10+ years of experience in Linux system administration, with at least 2 years in a leadership or senior technical role.
* Deep understanding of Linux operating systems (RHEL, CentOS, Ubuntu) and associated technologies.
* Strong knowledge of networking principles, including TCP/IP, DNS, and firewalls.
* Experience with automation and configuration management tools (e.g., Ansible, Puppet, Chef).
* Proficiency in scripting languages (e.g., Bash, Python).
* Experience with virtualization (e.g., VMware, KVM) and containerization (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes).
* Familiarity with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP) and hybrid cloud environments.
* Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to work under pressure.

Strong communication and interpersonal skills.

Job Types: Full-time, Permanent

Pay: Up to ₹75,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person
